# Från pokerbordet till fondförvaltning

**Feed**: placerapodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Former professional poker player Joel Forsberg (guest) presents his new Amos Value fund. It follows a disciplined, contrarian value strategy: buy companies with low-valued cash flows at a 10-20%+ discount to their estimated fair value, and sell once that value is reached. The portfolio of about 30 holdings trades at around 12x cash flow. He argues for AcadeMedia despite the political risk, holds Spiltan Invest as a discount-to-net-asset-value play, and likes Inwido and property stocks such as Balder and Diös. He was disappointed by Revolution Race's weak organic growth. He expects to underperform clearly in a speculative bull market.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

~5% position; ~7x cash flow, strong serial acquirer. Guest says the valuation would be double without political risk.

#### Reasoning

Guest sees AcadeMedia as one of the cheapest stocks on the exchange at 7-8x cash flow, with excellent 15-year growth in sales and profit through small add-on acquisitions. ~40% of operating profit comes from abroad, which limits the damage from a Swedish ban on school profits. The political risk is accepted through position sizing (~5%). He expects long inquiries even after the election.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a ban on school profits is introduced
- if the election leads to fast legislation against profits in schools
- if the price reaches the estimated fair value

> *"Att få det bolaget till 7–8 gånger kassaflödet är alldeles för billigt. Hade det inte funnits en politisk risk hade värderingen varit det dubbla."*

---

### 🟢 INWI — Inwido | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

One of the larger holdings; clearly better report after a tough period, low valuation on current earnings.

#### Reasoning

Guest likes Inwido's decentralised group of self-running subsidiaries. After a tough period the latest report was clearly better. The stock is still fairly cheap on current earnings and would look very cheap with a modest market tailwind. Stena's stake increase is not seen as changing the case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the recovery in earnings stalls
- if the price reaches the estimated fair value

> *"Det är ändå relativt lågt värderat på nuvarande vinster och får de bara lite, lite medvind så ser det otroligt billigt ut."*

---

### 🟡 RVRC — Revolution Race | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Still held, but guest disappointed by weak organic growth; acquisition reasonably sized with no debt.

#### Reasoning

Organic growth was only a couple of percent. The CEO's wording suggests the core business isn't growing, only the new acquisition. The I Can I Will deal changes the capital-allocation story but is reasonably sized with a debt-free balance sheet, and fast growth at the acquired company could make it a good deal. Slightly lukewarm outlook.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the core business keeps failing to grow organically
- if the I Can I Will acquisition stops growing or fails
- if further, larger acquisitions put the balance sheet at risk

> *"Så det var lite sämre rapport och lite ljummare utsikter."*

---

### 🟢 BALD-B — Balder | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Holding at 10x income from property management, the lowest valuation ever; strong history.

#### Reasoning

Guest sees property stocks at possibly record-low valuations on income from property management, with 25-45% discounts to net asset value. Balder historically grew 30% per year, handled the rate-hike period well and trades at 10x income from property management. Interest cover around 3x means a 25bp hike is manageable and likely already priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sharply higher interest rates squeeze interest cover toward 1x
- if the price reaches the estimated fair value

> *"Vi har Balder, som handlas tio gånger förvaltningsresultatet."*

---

### 🟢 DIOS — Diös | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Property holding bought on the sector's record-low valuations and discounts to net asset value.

#### Reasoning

Part of the fund's contrarian property allocation. Guest focuses on property cash flows rather than book-value write-downs; the sector is at very low valuations with large discounts to net asset value. Rising rates would hurt somewhat but are likely priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a sharp rate increase hurts earnings
- if the price reaches the estimated fair value

> *"Sen har vi även Diös, t.ex."*

---

### 🟢 NEWA-B — New Wave | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Given as an example: fair value ~120 SEK vs a price of ~90, i.e. ~25% upside.

#### Reasoning

Guest uses New Wave to explain margin of safety: fair value ~120 SEK based on cash flow and earnings, price ~90. With 6-7% annual growth at a constant multiple he expects ~10% annual return even without a re-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the price reaches ~120 SEK fair value
- if earnings growth falls short of expectations

> *"Säg New Wave skulle vi kunna ta som exempel. Vi tycker att den är värd omkring 120 kronor. Så handlas den då på kring 90"*
